_doc: CONVERSION-SURFACES-W2 CH1 AC evidence. The spec asks for 380px/1400px SCREENSHOTS in audits/. This repo has no headless browser dependency (playwright/puppeteer both absent) and has never committed a PNG under audits/, so adding one to satisfy a screenshot AC would be a dependency change outside the chapter's Scope. Substituted with the MEASUREMENT the screenshots exist to establish, taken in a real browser at the declared widths. Screenshots were also rendered in-session for the architect's visual review (Manual step 1). Fact-honest relaxation, logged per CLAUDE.md.
instrument: Claude Browser pane, worktree landing/ served over http://127.0.0.1:8792 (NOT the deployed site — these are pre-deploy build artifacts)

AC1_pill_visible_at_380px_without_openin.predicate: querySelector('[data-mobile-signup-pill]').offsetParent !== null AND #mobile-menu is display:none AND #mobile-menu does not contain the pill

AC1b_tap_target_wcag_2_5_5.note: SIGNUP_PILL alone renders ~26px (px-3 py-1 text-xs); min-h-[44px] inline-flex items-center is applied ONLY to the sm:hidden instance.

AC2_desktop_nav_unchanged.predicate_a: the ONLY delta to the generated nav region is the sm:hidden cluster — removing it yields the origin/main fixture BYTE-FOR-BYTE
AC2_desktop_nav_unchanged.predicate_b: at 1400px the cluster computes display:none and the desktop row geometry is unchanged

AC3_parity_gate.red_proven_once: MOBILE_NAV_PARITY_VERDICT=FAIL over the same 39 surfaces before build_nav.mjs regeneration — 38 offenders, each '[expected exactly 1 data-mobile-signup-pill, found 0]'
AC3_parity_gate.self_test: 5 cases: clean=PASS/0, pill-inside-panel=FAIL/1, pill-absent=FAIL/1, two-pills=FAIL/1, empty-corpus=INDETERMINATE/3; token AND token->exit-code mapping asserted
AC3_parity_gate.self_test_proven_able_to_fail: the position predicate was replaced with `if false; then`; the suite reported SELF-TEST: FAIL (pill inside collapsed panel) — got PASS rc=0, want FAIL rc=1, and the run emitted MOBILE_NAV_PARITY_VERDICT=INDETERMINATE. Restored and re-verified green.

out_of_invariant.detail: The SEO article pages (landing/ai-agents-crypto-trade-calls.html and siblings) plus landing/privacy.html and landing/terms.html carry the brand footer but NO site nav at all, so they ship no header and are outside invariant A and B by construction. They are NOT offenders and are NOT counted in the 39. They DO receive the CH3 conversion band via the footer injector. Recorded because 'the pill is on every surface' would otherwise be read as literally every page.
out_of_invariant.follow_up: WIS candidate — a public page with no site nav has no header door at any width.
